title: Grateful Dead Live at Cassell Coliseum, Virginia Polytechnic on 1978-04-14
lineage: Transfer: DAT > Sony PCM-R500 > Tascam DA-3000 > wav 16-bit/44.1k - Transferred by Charlie Miller Lineage: wav > Adobe Audition 3 > iZotope RX7 Advanced > iZotope Ozone 5 Advanced > CD Wave > TLH > Flac 16
source: Source: SBD Master Reel (7" two track @ 7 1/2 ips - recorded by Betty Cantor) > PCM501ES @ 44.055 kHz > DAT (44k) - From the Tim Dalton collection.

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of an unforgettable show highlighted by Black Peter, Ship of Fools and Dire Wolf.
ai_review.review: The recording delivers crystal‑clear soundboard fidelity that fans describe as both ‘chunky’ and sweet, while the performance shines with a standout Black Peter, a sparkling Ship of Fools and a powerful Dire Wolf. Reviewers rave about Jerry’s soaring guitar work and the overall high‑energy flow of the set, making this April ’78 show one of the year’s peaks.

ai_rating.rationale: All three reviews are highly positive (5, 5, 4 stars) and praise both the musical performance and recording quality; consistent enthusiasm across multiple reviewers yields a strong confidence level.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No complaints about drop‑outs or muddiness; reviewers note crisp, clear soundboard capture with pleasant tonal character.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Reviewers describe the show as sparkling and full of peaks, with a strong first set (Dire Wolf) and an especially memorable second‑set vibe.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for wailing and great guitar tone throughout the performance.
